title: Erithacus rubecula - European Robin XC559972
author: Marie-Lan Taÿ Pamart
changes: European robin (Erithacus rubecula) singing one phrase of its warbling song from a tree in a mixed forest in France, a recording shared through Xeno-canto (XC559972). Trimmed to 3.10–5.85 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
